column15: {=ARM_KR_106_1_U}To convince the crown in King's Landing that the dead are real, Jon Snow leads a handful of volunteers beyond the Wall to bring back a single wight. They find one in a blizzard, and with it the whole army of the dead, which drives them onto a rock in the middle of a frozen lake.
column16: {=ARM_KR_106_1_L}They hold out for a night and a day while the ice slowly thickens around them, and a red priest dies of the cold. Then fire falls from the sky: Daenerys Targaryen has flown north on her dragons to save the northerner who would not kneel.

column15: {=ARM_KR_106_2_U}As the dragons scatter the dead, the Night King rises in his stirrups at the edge of the lake and weighs a spear of ice in his hand. He throws it as a farmer throws a stone, and one of the dragons falls screaming through the ice into the black water.
column16: {=ARM_KR_106_2_L}Jon is left behind and saved only by a rider long thought dead. On the ship south he calls Daenerys his queen. Behind them the dead drag the fallen dragon out of the lake on chains, and its eyes open blue.
